apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
    labels:
        app: web-violating
        fathom.dev/mutated-by: add-default-securitycontext
        team: pirates
    name: web-violating
    namespace: s3
spec:
    replicas: 1
    selector:
        matchLabels:
            app: web-violating
    template:
        metadata:
            labels:
                app: web-violating
        spec:
            containers:
                - image: nginx:1.27
                  name: web
                  resources:
                    requests:
                        cpu: 10m
                        memory: 16Mi
            securityContext:
                runAsNonRoot: true
